description: Add a single emoji reaction to a message as the bot. Requires the Add Reactions and Read Message History permissions. Use discord_remove_reactions to undo. Idempotent: re-adding the bot's existing reaction has no effect.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread containing the message.

emoji.description: Unicode emoji (e.g. '👍') or a custom emoji in 'name:id' format.

message_id.description: ID of the message to react to.

name: discord_add_reaction
